programs.title: Leave
programs.desc: Henry Harper is a successful novelist who has it all. But after surviving a recent trauma he finds himself haunted by a dream that terrifies him. Convinced that the only way to understand what the dream means is to write his way through it. Starring Rick Gomez, Frank John Hughes, Vinessa Shaw

programs.title: Love Simple
programs.desc: Adam and Seta fall in love in a Brooklyn laundromat, but they’ve each got a secret and it’s a full-time job to keep they’re lies straight.

programs.title: Life Tastes Good
programs.desc: A quirky tale that brings together a murder, poison mushrooms and a mysterious woman to reveal the ephemeral beauty of life and the unforgiving nature of death.

programs.title: Death and Texas
programs.desc: Football superstar "Barefoot" Bobby Briggs of the Austin Steers has been convicted of murder. Will he be allowed to play with his team on Megabowl Sunday before he is executed? Starring Charles Durning, Steve Harris, Corbin Bernsen

programs.title: Combat Girls
programs.desc: Marisa, a 20-year-old German girl, hates foreigners, Jews, cops, and everyone she finds guilty for the decline of her country. She provokes, drinks, fights and her next tattoo will be a portrait of Adolf Hitler.

programs.title: Dot Com Mom
programs.desc: In this fish out of water tale, a traditional Indian house wife, visits her successful son in the USA but this simple mother cannot cope with the modern ways and soon finds herself in trouble.

programs.title: Dark Planet
programs.desc: Two sides, one known as the Alphas and the other the Rebels, struggle in a brutal war on Earth and in outer space. Starring Paul Mercurio and Michael York.

programs.title: Der Samaurai
programs.desc: Der Samurai is a German mind-bender about shape-shifting cross-dressers, bloody decapitations, repressed sexual desires and small town life.

programs.title: Der Bunker
programs.desc: A young student seeks quiet and solitude to focus on an important work but ends up as the teacher of a peculiar boy who is home-schooled by his parents in an isolated bunker mansion.

programs.title: Death Of A Soldier
programs.desc: Based on a true story, James Coburn portrays a military lawyer assigned to defend a confessed psychotic killer. Set in WWII and the uneasy US-Australian military alliance. The accused killer claims to have killed 3 women in order to possess their voices. Starring James Coburn, Bill Hunter and Reb Brown

programs.title: Divorce Invitation
programs.desc: Mike Christian, a happily married man runs into his high school sweetheart Alex, and after all these years, sparks still fly. When Mike is determined Alex is his true soul mate, he realizes he has a huge problem-he signed an iron-clad pre-nuptial agreement and his wife will not let him out of the marriage. Starring Jamie-Lynn Sigler, Jonathan Bennett, Elliott Gould

programs.title: Dark Nemesis
programs.desc: A group of desperate soldiers hatch a plan to steal a Warlord's treasure and start a new life. Faced with the threat of a horrific death at the hands of the Warlord's executioners, the men escape into a desolate and forbidden land known only as the Shadowlands. Starring Kyle Walsh, Aaron Farb, Debra Lopez
